_README: A one-sentence description for every element that has a page.
Every entry here was written by an AI, not taken from a normative document,
and the pages mark it with a badge whose tooltip says so. The distinction
matters: a rule in this project carries the clause it comes from and can be
checked against a new edition of the specification. These sentences cannot.
They are navigation aids, not statements of the norm.
Where the ASN.1 module comments a field, that comment is shown too, below the
description and attributed to the module. It usually says how a value is
encoded rather than what it is, which is why it does not replace this file.
Kept apart from the generator so that correcting a sentence is an edit, not a
code change. If one is wrong, fix it here.
akaParameter: Profile element carrying the AKA authentication parameters of a NAA: algorithm, key and OPc. Clause 8.4.2.
cdmaParameter: Profile element carrying the CAVE authentication parameters of a CSIM. Clause 8.4.3.
ssimEapTLSParameters: Profile element carrying the EAP-TLS parameters of an SSIM. Clause 8.4.4.
algoParameter: One algorithm's parameter set inside a PE-AKAParameter. Which fields apply depends on algorithmID: milenage, tuak or usim-test-algorithm.
cd: Profile element creating DF CD and the files beneath it, from the template of Annex A 9.3.
telecom: Profile element creating DF TELECOM and the files beneath it, from the template of Annex A 9.4.
usim: Profile element creating an ADF USIM and its mandatory files, from the template of Annex A 9.5.1.
isim: Profile element creating an ADF ISIM and its mandatory files.
csim: Profile element creating an ADF CSIM and its mandatory files.
ssim: Profile element creating an ADF SSIM and its mandatory files.
eap: Profile element creating a DF EAP under an ADF, one per EAP method the application supports.
phonebook: Profile element creating DF Phonebook in the context of a USIM ADF.
gsm-access: Profile element creating DF GSM-ACCESS in the context of a USIM ADF.
df-5gs: Profile element creating DF 5GS under a previously created USIM.
df-saip: Profile element creating DF SAIP under a previously created USIM.
df-snpn: Profile element creating DF SNPN under a previously created USIM.
df-5gprose: Profile element creating DF 5G ProSe under a previously created USIM.
opt-usim: Profile element creating the USIM files that the template marks as not created by default.
opt-isim: Profile element creating the ISIM files that the template marks as not created by default.
opt-csim: Profile element creating the CSIM files that the template marks as not created by default.
opt-iot: Profile element creating the IoT files that the template marks as not created by default.
securityDomain: Profile element creating a security domain. The first one in the package is the MNO-SD by definition, clause 8.6.2.
application: Profile element loading and installing an application, after the security domain it is associated with.
rfm: Profile element configuring a Remote File Management instance: its AID, the security domain it belongs to and the TARs that address it. Clause 8.8.
pinCodes: Profile element defining PIN codes. Which references it may use depends on the file-system element before it, its PIN context.
pukCodes: Profile element defining PUK codes. Used once per package, right after the MF in a Full Profile.
PINConfiguration: One PIN inside a PE-PINCodes: its key reference, value, retry counters and optionally the PUK that unblocks it.
PUKConfiguration: One PUK inside a PE-PUKCodes: its key reference, value and retry counters.
KeyObject: One key of a security domain. Unique per keyIdentifier and keyVersionNumber pair, clause 8.6.3.
pinconfig: The list of PIN configurations of a PE-PINCodes, at most 26 entries.
pinValue: The PIN itself, eight bytes, padded where the code is shorter.
maxNumOfAttemps-retryNumLeft: Both counters packed into one byte: the maximum number of attempts in the high nibble, the retries left in the low one.
createFCP: An FCP creating a file without a template, inside a PE-GenericFileManagement. Clause 8.3.5 sets the minimum parameters, which differ from the template case.
fileManagementCMD: The sequence of file management operations of a PE-GenericFileManagement.
identification: The number identifying a profile element within the package. Unique across the package, clause 8.1.3.
templateID: The OID of the template a profile element instantiates, from the list assigned in Annex B.
iccid: The ICCID in the Profile Header, an ITU E.118 representation padded with 'F'. Clause 8.2.1 says the eUICC neither checks nor uses this value in a Full Profile.
specialFileInformation: The File Status Byte of a file, inside the proprietary information. Only bits b8 and b7 are defined; the rest are reserved.
repeatPattern: A byte pattern repeated to fill the file. Mutually exclusive with fillPattern.
fileDetails: The File Details of a BER-TLV structured EF, mandatory for such files and forbidden otherwise.
extraditeSecurityDomainAID: The AID of the security domain an application instance is extradited to. Absent means the MNO-SD.
minimumSecurityLevel: The Minimum Security Level of an RFM instance, coded per ETSI TS 102 226.
restrictParameter: The Restrict parameter of a security domain's openPersoData.
tarList: The TARs that address an RFM instance. At least one where the list is present at all.
keyDerivationFunctions: The AT_KDF values an SSIM accepts during EAP-TLS authentication.
SEQUENCE: An anonymous inline SEQUENCE of the module. It appears here because it has no type name of its own, not because it is an element a profile author writes.
fileDescriptor: The file control parameters of a file: its identifier, name, access rules and PIN status. Its first byte gives the file's accessibility, type and structure per ETSI TS 102 221 Table 11.5.
fileID: The two-byte identifier of a file. For an ADF it is a temporary value used only while the profile is built.
dfName: The AID of an ADF. Annex A calls this the AID in its Parameters column.
efFileSize: The size reserved for the body of an EF, excluding structural information.
linkPath: The path of the file this one links to. An empty value turns a template link back into an independent file.
shortEFID: The Short File Identifier of an EF, coded in bits b8 to b4.
lcsi: The Life Cycle Status of the file after creation, coded per ETSI TS 102 221 Table 11.7b.
securityAttributesReferenced: The access rules of a file, given as a record number in EF ARR, optionally preceded by the ARR's own file identifier.
pinStatusTemplateDO: The list of PIN key references that guard an ADF or DF and the files beneath it.
proprietaryEFInfo: Proprietary file information: fill or repeat pattern, and the BER-TLV parameters where the file is BER-TLV structured.
fillPattern: A byte pattern written once into the file, padded with its last byte. Mutually exclusive with repeatPattern.
maximumFileSize: The maximum size of a BER-TLV structured EF.
mf: Profile element creating the MF and the files at MF level, from the template of Annex A 9.2.
ef-ad: The EF AD of a NAA, created from the template and modified by the profile where it differs.
ef-fdn: The EF FDN of a NAA, created from the template and modified by the profile where it differs.
instanceAID: The AID of the RFM instance. Where no tarList is given, bytes 13 to 15 of this AID supply the TAR.
securityDomainAID: The AID of the security domain an RFM instance or application package belongs to. Absent means the MNO-SD.
adfRFMAccess: The ADF an RFM script selects by default. Absent means the RFM instance is tied to the MF.
keyAccess: Where a key may be used from, coded per GlobalPlatform Card Specification 11.1.9.
keyReference: The key reference identifying a PIN or PUK, from the values of Table 9.3 of ETSI TS 102 221.
unblockingPINReference: The PUK that unblocks this PIN. Absent means no PUK applies.
applicationSpecificParametersC9: Application-specific installation parameters, coded per GlobalPlatform.
cumulativeGrantedNonVolatileMemory: The non-volatile memory quota granted to a security domain and its applications.
cumulativeGrantedVolatileMemory: The volatile memory quota granted to a security domain and its applications.
userInteractionContactlessParameters: Contactless user-interaction parameters, coded per GlobalPlatform Amendment C.
authenticationKey: The A-Key used for CAVE authentication in a CSIM.
ssd: The shared secret data for CAVE authentication.
hrpdAccessAuthenticationData: The shared secrets for HRPD access authentication.
simpleIPAuthenticationData: The CHAP parameters for simple IP authentication.
mobileIPAuthenticationData: The authentication parameters for mobile IP.
rotationConstants: Milenage rotation constants. Ignored for TUAK and the test algorithm.
xoringConstants: Milenage XOR constants. Ignored for TUAK and the test algorithm.
numberOfKeccak: The number of Keccak permutation rounds for TUAK.
sqnAgeLimit: The sequence number age limit of the AKA algorithm.
javacard: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must provide a Java Card runtime for this profile to install.
coap: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must support remote management over CoAP.
dns-resolution: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must support DNS resolution.
eaka: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must support the enhanced AKA algorithm.
s16mode: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must support S16 mode.
scp11ac: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must support SCP11 as defined in GlobalPlatform Amendment F.
suci-nswo: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must support the additional 5G options.
uir5GProSe: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must support 5G ProSe usage information reporting.
usatAppPairing: Flag in the Profile Header: the eUICC must support USAT Application Pairing.
